races.name: mallardjewellers.com Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WOLF RAYET showed improved form upped to the highest level on his final 2 outings last season, making the frame in the Anniversary Hurdle at Aintree, and he can take advantage of this drop into maiden company. Heading the list of dangers is Get Out Of My Way, who was only narrowly denied on hurdling debut, ahead of Old Habits.

  1. WOLF RAYET (IRE)
  2. GET OUT OF MY WAY (IRE)
  3. OLD HABITS (IRE)

races.name: WKD Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CRYSTAL ISLAND looked potentially smart when winning both starts over hurdles last season and Nicky Henderson's expensive point recruit can maintain his unbeaten record now chasing. Spectacularsunrise would've likely scored over C&D 3 weeks ago if not for a late fall so has to be respected, with Four Springs and The Gray Ghost completing the shortlist in a hot race.

  1. CRYSTAL ISLAND (IRE)
  2. SPECTACULARSUNRISE
  3. FOUR SPRINGS (IRE)

races.name: Weatherite Air Conditioning Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
On the back of an encouraging reappearance at Ascot 2 weeks ago, SHAKEYATAILFEATHER is perched just 1 lb above her last winning mark, gained at Kelso around this time last year and she looks primed to strike. Highlands Legacy won on last season's return to the track and represents a yard in excellent order so he's a definite threat, along with Authoceltic.

  1. SHAKEYATAILFEATHER (IRE)
  2. HIGHLANDS LEGACY
  3. AUTHOCELTIC (FR)

races.name: Oddschecker Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (Registered As The Tom Olliver Handicap Chase) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
HAVAILA is a chaser very much on the upgrade and could still be ahead of his mark given the manner of his bet365 Gold Cup win at Sandown. King of Answers and Ask Brewster are both expected to bounce back so they head the dangers.

  1. HAVAILA (IRE)
  2. KING OF ANSWERS (IRE)
  3. ASK BREWSTER (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Greatwood Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Unexposed LET IT RAIN and Harry Lowes head a remarkably strong hand for the Dan Skelton yard, with the former narrowly preferred off a mark that still looks lenient. The Hardest Geezer makes plenty of each-way appeal at the early prices, with last year's runner-up Helnwein set to be in the hunt for another in-frame finish.

  1. LET IT RAIN
  2. HARRY LOWES (IRE)
  3. THE HARDEST GEEZER (IRE)

races.name: Three Counties Christmas Open NH Flat Race (Listed) (Registered As The William Kidd) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Saint Clovis caused a bit of a surprise when taking this last year and representing the same connections, NEW GRANGE can repeat the feat with improvement on the cards. Cameron de Fiacre made a successful debut at Fontwell back in the spring and with his yard remaining in red-hot form, he's put forward as the main danger. Berkstar and Dundee Law are another couple fancied to be in the mix, too.

  1. NEW GRANGE (IRE)
  2. CAMERON DE FIACRE (FR)
  3. BERKSTAR (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Casino 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
NORMAN PRINCE caught the eye with his finishing effort when runner-up in a French bumper and can make a winning start over hurdles having since joined the Gigginstown/Elliott team. Fellow hurdling newcomers Huff'n'puff and Sunrush are also much respected on the strength of their Flat form.

  1. NORMAN PRINCE (FR)
  2. HUFF'N'PUFF
  3. SUNRUSH (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
The form of LA VALSERINE's French bumper worked out extremely well and, having joined the all-conquering Mullins yard, she's taken to land what looks a warm mares maiden on hurdling debut. Moonverrin reached a useful level in bumpers and looks the pick of the potential dangers, though several others, including Royale Walk demand respect.

  1. LA VALSERINE (FR)
  2. MOONVERRIN (IRE)
  3. ROYALE WALK (IRE)

races.name: Gaeil Colmcille GAA Kells 'Day At The Races' Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
MR CAULFIELD would have won but for a late fall at Carlisle on Monday, and he can gain compensation. Sheer Raz, Annarubyrose and Mary's Pride all look plausible each-way angles in this big-field handicap.

  1. MR CAULFIELD (IRE)
  2. SHEER RAZ (IRE)
  3. ANNARUBYROSE (IRE)

races.name: John Lynch Carpets & Flooring Monksfield Novice Hurdle (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
Grade 1 bumper winner WITH NOLIMIT is fancied to make it 2-2 over hurdles. There's better to come from Reaching High and Pat O's Rock in this sphere, too, and they head the dangers in an interesting event.

  1. WITH NOLIMIT (FR)
  2. REACHING HIGH (IRE)
  3. PAT O'S ROCK (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 50' Tara Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
PADDY'S MILESTONE scored with something in hand in this race last year and he is fancied to land the prize again given his good record fresh. He gets the vote ahead of Mart Lane, who took another step forward when opening his account at Listowel, while Cool Native remains capable of better as she goes handicapping.

  1. PADDY'S MILESTONE (IRE)
  2. MART LANE (IRE)
  3. COOL NATIVE (IRE)

races.name: Race And Stay Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
A most interesting beginners chase with the narrow vote in favour of CLASSICAL CREEK. Absent since finishing down the field in Grade 1 company over hurdles at Naas in January, his profile prior to that was a most positive one and firmly appealing as the type to make an even better chaser, he can enhance his yard's solid recent record in this race. Fruit de Mer and Kopeck de Mee are others making plenty of appeal, with Forty Coats rounding off the shortlist.

  1. CLASSICAL CREEK
  2. FRUIT DE MER (IRE)
  3. KOPECK DE MEE (FR)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting Troytown Handicap Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
Gordon Elliott is responsible for half the field so holds every chance of winning this for a record eighth time, with THE ENABLER looking the pick dropped to a more suitable trip. His stablemate Better Days Ahead has a good record here so is another to consider, while Uhavemeinstitches is lurking on a dangerous mark if it all comes together.

  1. THE ENABLER (IRE)
  2. BETTER DAYS AHEAD (IRE)
  3. UHAVEMEINSTITCHES (IRE)

races.name: Coolmore N.H. Sires Hurricane Lane Irish EBF Mares Flat Race (Listed)
races.verdict:
SARAHS LAWN looked potentially smart when justifying confidence in good style in a similar event at Gowran 6 weeks ago so looks capable of defying a penalty. All Noise is feared most after her impressive debut success at Limerick, with Brosna Shine best of the others.

  1. SARAHS LAWN (IRE)
  2. ALL NOISE (IRE)
  3. BROSNA SHINE

races.name: StoneX Commodities Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Hard to discount any in a tight-looking handicap. KAMAXOS is interesting in this sort of grade and may add another winner to Charlie Longsdon's recent haul. Maccarellu is potentially well treated if back on song, with Western Cross also appealing at the weights.

  1. KAMAXOS (FR)
  2. MACCARELLU (FR)
  3. WESTERN CROSS (IRE)

races.name: StoneX Southern National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Prolific in handicap hurdles last season, MASK OF ZORRO picked up where he left off when making a successful transition to chasing at Newton Abbot (3¼m) 18 days ago. Totally unexposed at marathon trips and hailing from a stable who continue in rude health, this dual course winner looks a major player again. Jeu d'Opale tackles a much longer trip on return but appeals as being on a good mark, with last year's winner Livin On Luco and hat-trick seeker Paper Mill also shortlisted.

  1. MASK OF ZORRO (IRE)
  2. JEU D'OPALE (FR)
  3. LIVIN ON LUCO (IRE)

races.name: StoneX Bullion Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BASS HUNTER was one of the best British-trained bumper horses last season and judged on his easy win on hurdling debut 4 weeks ago, he's a smart novice in the making. He's very likely to outclass these under a penalty, though expensive point recruit Catchem Black should ensure he doesn't have it all his own way.

  1. BASS HUNTER (FR)
  2. CATCHEM BLACK (IRE)
  3. CASPER CHARLIE (IRE)

races.name: StoneX Payments Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SILVER STATE's stamina needs to be taken on trust but there's no doubting he's the clear pick on Flat form (useful 4-time winner) and he could well be worth siding with having joined a yard that do particularly well with such types in this discipline. Pass The Buck and Lion In Zion may emerge best of those with prior hurdles experience, whilst James Choice is another interesting recruit from the Flat.

  1. SILVER STATE (IRE)
  2. PASS THE BUCK (IRE)
  3. LION IN ZION (FR)

races.name: John Rogerson Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MAJESTIC MOMENT usually goes well at this track, arrives fit and in-form and, back off his last winning mark, is taken to notch up a third course success. Fay Ce Que Voudras arrives in search of a 4-timer and rates the main danger despite not being out since March. Chasing debutants Just Call Me Buzz and What A Dragon are both worthy of interest and any support should be taken very seriously.

  1. MAJESTIC MOMENT (IRE)
  2. FAY CE QUE VOUDRAS (IRE)
  3. JUST CALL ME BUZZ

races.name: Maria's And Aidie's 25th Wedding Anniversary Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for a few of these, but ASTA LA VISTA ran his best race when finishing runner-up at Bangor back in the spring and with this extra distance a possible catalyst for further progress, Tom Britten's new recruit is taken to get off the mark. County Champs has had plenty of goes and he may have to settle for another silver medal, with Charles Morin and Black Dakota taken to fight out third.

  1. ASTA LA VISTA
  2. COUNTY CHAMPS (IRE)
  3. CHARLES MORIN
